backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Mahalaxmi Health Care backend, handling contact form submissions, appointment requests, domain draft management, user profiles, and admin-gated access control with a decommission mode toggle.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the About page (AboutPage.tsx) was updated to include the full Mahalaxmi Health Care occupational health description paragraph verbatim as readable body copy.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary file listing short descriptions of all frontend source files, covering pages, components, hooks, styles, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that imports Tailwind layers and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app with SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter Card tags, favicon links, and the root div for mounting the React application.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt allowing all crawlers full site access and pointing to the sitemap URL.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing the five main site URLs (home, about, services, contact, appointments) with change frequencies and priorities.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for all pages (home, about, services, contact, appointments, domain-draft, decommissioned, 404), all wrapped in SiteLayout.
frontend/src/components/about/FacilityHi: About page section component displaying a grid of facility images with overlay captions and three highlight cards for infrastructure, team, and technology.
frontend/src/components/forms/Appointmen: A React form component for submitting appointment requests, with fields for name, contact details, preferred date/time, department selection, and notes, including validation and success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/forms/ContactFor: A React form component for submitting general contact messages, with fields for name, contact info, subject, and message, including client-side validation and success/error alerts.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: A full-width hero section for the home page featuring a background medical image with gradient overlay, headline text, and buttons to navigate to appointments or contact pages.
frontend/src/components/home/ServiceHigh: A home page section that displays a grid of six key medical service cards with icons and descriptions, plus a button linking to the full services page.
A reusable page hero section component that renders an optional badge, title, subtitle, and children within a centered, gradient-background layout.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeroI: A reusable image component for page heroes that applies cache-busting to generated assets and shows a fallback error state with a refresh prompt if the image fails to load.
frontend/src/components/layout/Section.t: A simple layout wrapper component that renders a styled section element with a container div, supporting default or muted background variants.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: The site-wide footer component displaying the hospital logo, quick navigation links, operating hours, and contact information, along with a build version and attribution link.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Sticky site header component with an emergency contact bar, logo, desktop navigation links, and a mobile hamburger menu. Highlights the active route and includes a 'Book Appointment' CTA button.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Root layout wrapper that composes SiteHeader, SiteFooter, and SeoManager around a main content area with a skip-to-content accessibility link.
frontend/src/components/seo/Organization: Renders a JSON-LD script tag with Schema.org MedicalOrganization structured data for the hospital to aid search engine indexing.
frontend/src/components/seo/SeoManager.t: Headless component that dynamically updates document head tags (title, meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph, Twitter Card, Google verification) based on the current route.
frontend/src/components/shared/PdfExport: Button component that triggers the browser's print dialog to export the current page as a PDF, temporarily setting the document title to a provided filename.
frontend/src/components/shared/ServiceCa: Reusable card component that displays a service with a Lucide icon, title, and description, with hover styling effects.
frontend/src/config/branding.ts: Exports the hospital name constant and a helper function for composing page titles with the brand name.
frontend/src/config/buildInfo.ts: Exports build ID and version helpers sourced from the VITE_BUILD_ID environment variable, falling back to a dev timestamp for cache-busting.
frontend/src/config/contactDetails.ts: Centralized configuration for hospital contact details (phone, email, address, hours) with helper functions for emergency and main phone tel links.
frontend/src/config/seo.ts: Defines site URL, default SEO metadata, and per-route SEO overrides, plus helper functions to retrieve titles, descriptions, and canonical URLs by path.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor, using the current Internet Identity for authenticated calls and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDomainDraft.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving a domain draft via the backend actor, with cache invalidation on successful save.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing identity, login/clear functions, and login status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitAppointmentR: Mutation hook that submits an appointment request to the backend actor, normalizing error messages for user-friendly display.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitContact.ts: Mutation hook that submits a contact form to the backend actor, with error normalization for common failure cases.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm peach color palette in both light and dark modes, plus utility classes for layout and accessibility.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page for Mahalaxmi Health Care displaying the organization's description, core values, and facility highlights with a floating PDF export button.
frontend/src/pages/AppointmentRequestPag: Appointment booking page that shows process steps, consultation images, and renders the AppointmentRequestForm component with a floating PDF export button.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page displaying address, phone, and email info cards alongside a ContactForm component, with a hero image and floating PDF export button.
frontend/src/pages/DecommissionedPage.ts: Static page shown when a service is temporarily unavailable, displaying a maintenance notice with warning icon and placeholder images.
frontend/src/pages/DoctorsPage.tsx: Empty file with no content; the DoctorsPage component has not been implemented yet.
frontend/src/pages/DomainDraftPage.tsx: Authenticated admin page for viewing and saving domain configuration drafts, gating access behind Internet Identity login and using custom hooks for CRUD operations.
frontend/src/pages/EmergencyPage.tsx: Empty file with no content; the EmergencyPage component has not been implemented yet.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page for Mahalaxmi Health Care featuring a hero section, trust signals, stats bar, and facilities showcase with a floating PDF export button.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: 404 error page with a hero, navigation illustrations, and a button to return to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Services listing page displaying 17 medical specialties as cards with icons, descriptions, and a floating PDF export button.
frontend/src/utils/generatedAssets.ts: Utility that detects generated asset URLs and appends a build-ID cache-busting query parameter to them.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, spacing, shadows, border radii, and font families, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking the Mahalaxmi Health Care website's existing features, a pending feature request to add the full company description to the About page, and general project configuration.
